title: GeoLeaf Profile
description: profile.json — core profile metadata and configuration. UI, basemaps, search and table config live in separate files referenced via the Files section. Strict schema (PRF-SCHEMA, Profile Contract v1): additionalProperties:false on fixed-shape objects, _comment* tolerated. modules.<id> blocks stay open (plugin-owned, INV-CONFIG).

id.description: Unique profile identifier. Must match the directory name.

displayLabel.description: Short label shown in the profile switcher (capability `profile-switcher`). Optional — falls back to `label`, then to the profile id. Kept separate from `label` because the latter is descriptive ('Réseau ferroviaire France') where a selector needs to be terse ('France Rail').

icon.description: Emoji shown before the label in the profile switcher. Optional — absent renders the label alone.

bundleFile.description: INJECTÉE PAR LE BUILD, jamais écrite à la main : nom du bundle de configuration agrégé, déposé à côté de ce fichier par l'étape de groupage. ⚠️ Elle n'existe que dans les profils DÉPLOYÉS ; un profil de `profiles/` qui la porte est le signe qu'un artefact a été recopié vers la source. Déclarée ici parce que le schéma est `additionalProperties: false` et que le profil déployé doit valider — sans quoi le build produit, à chaque exécution, un artefact que le schéma du dépôt interdit.

Files.description: Relative paths to companion config files loaded at startup (profile layout v2: config/core/*.json + config/plugins/<moduleId>.json).

themesFile.description: Path to the themes file (layout v2: config/core/themes.json).

layersFile.description: Path to the layers registry (layout v2: config/core/layers.json).

basemapsFile.description: Path to the basemaps file (layout v2: config/core/basemaps.json).

uiFile.description: Path to the UI config file (layout v2: config/core/ui.json).

featuresFile.description: Path to the core features file (mapOptions…) — spread at the merged profile root (layout v2: config/core/features.json).

mappingFile.description: Path to the POI data normalization mapping (multi-source named blocks — layout v2: config/core/mapping.json). Consumed by ConfigNormalizer for layers declaring data.mapping.

modules.description: Module id -> plugin config file path (layout v2: config/plugins/<moduleId>.json). Each file content is merged into modules.<id> (Plugin Contract v1, INV-CONFIG).

padding.description: Map padding — array [vertical, horizontal] or object {top, right, bottom, left}.

maxPitch.description: Maximum map pitch in degrees (0-85). MapLibre default: 60.

target.description: Id of the HTML element that hosts the map, without `#` - it is resolved with `document.getElementById`, not as a CSS selector. Read by `GeoLeaf.boot()`; absent, the boot looks for `geoleaf-map`. `GeoLeaf.mount()` hosts the map in the element it is given and does not read this key.

id.description: Alias of `target`, read only when `target` is absent.

performance.description: Loading tuning. One key: the three once documented here (`maxConcurrentLayers`, `layerLoadDelay`, `fitBoundsOnThemeChange`) have no reader and are refused.

themeBatchSize.description: How many layers of a theme are revealed at a time when a theme is applied. Read by the theme applier; absent, 6.

modules.description: Configuration blocks keyed by module id — in-core capabilities such as `offline`, and plugins (Plugin Contract v1, INV-CONFIG). Every block stays additionalProperties:true: the schema does not describe its keys. A block is named below only if something reads it. For a plugin block, neither the core nor the plugin reports a key it does not know: a misspelled key is silently ignored.

offline.description: In-core offline capability — modules.offline.{enabled,cache}. Kept additionalProperties:true (opaque to the schema).

editor.description: Read by @geoleaf-plugins/editor, whose README lists its keys. Neither the core nor the plugin reports a key it does not know: a misspelled key is silently ignored.

geocoding.description: Read by @geoleaf-plugins/geocoding, whose README lists its keys. Neither the core nor the plugin reports a key it does not know: a misspelled key is silently ignored.

measure.description: Read by @geoleaf-plugins/measure, whose README lists its keys. Neither the core nor the plugin reports a key it does not know: a misspelled key is silently ignored.

navigation.description: Read by @geoleaf-plugins/navigation, whose README lists its keys. Neither the core nor the plugin reports a key it does not know: a misspelled key is silently ignored.

offline-ui.description: One key is read here, by the core's toolbar guard rather than by the plugin: `showButton` (boolean, default false) shows the cache button of @geoleaf-plugins/offline-ui, with `ui.showCacheButton` as legacy fallback. Nothing else in this block is read, and nothing reports a key it does not know.

position-share.description: Read by @geoleaf-plugins/position-share, whose README lists its keys. Neither the core nor the plugin reports a key it does not know: a misspelled key is silently ignored.

print.description: Read by @geoleaf-plugins/print, whose README lists its keys. Neither the core nor the plugin reports a key it does not know: a misspelled key is silently ignored.

routing.description: Read by @geoleaf-plugins/routing, whose README lists its keys. Neither the core nor the plugin reports a key it does not know: a misspelled key is silently ignored. ⚠️ `labelField` names a feature property that must ALSO appear in the `payloadFields` of the `action` widget declaring the entry-point button: the two are a cross-file rule no schema expresses, and a profile valid on both sides can still render a panel with no destination name.

table.description: Read by @geoleaf-plugins/table, whose README lists its keys. Neither the core nor the plugin reports a key it does not know: a misspelled key is silently ignored.
